capabilities: rank notes similar to the one being read using an on-device embedding index
search the vault by meaning rather than keywords
chat with the vault via RAG answers grounded in retrieved notes
reformat selected text into lists, tables, callouts or Mermaid diagrams
restructure notes into templates and suggest missing links
extras: Distributed through its own catalog rather than the community directory; the plugin API contract is marked experimental until a second consumer confirms it; a few UI strings are still German.
problem: Obsidian's search matches keywords, so finding notes by meaning or surfacing similar notes requires external services or per-note manual linking.

relations.evidence: If the LLM Lab plugin is installed, Vault Retrieval reports its LLM calls to it
The plugin's embedding index doubles as a retrieval backend for MCP clients (Claude Code, OpenClaw, …)

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible embedding and chat endpoint (e.g. Ollama or LM Studio)
Provider API key for hosted endpoints

summary: On-device semantic retrieval over a vault: related notes, semantic search, and grounded RAG chat using a configurable LLM endpoint.
